name: grok-agent
note: This example calls xAI directly and reads XAI_API_KEY on the device. Choose direct access when the installation keeps provider access on the device. For server-held provider access, set model.via to server and omit model.baseUrl and model.keyEnv; the task server then supplies xAI access. Both routes still use the task server for task operations. See docs/runtime.md#model-routing.
